posts.en:
dsh-git-status is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Specialized in Git branch and status handling: a Git status drawer on the right edge of the DSH web UI with a commit DAG lane graph, uncommitted changes and stash rows, inline diffs, right-click branch/tag actions, and one-click fetch from all remotes.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-9c6e5d8ccc766724fb4e.html
